verdict: Yes, as a craft-led brand. Eri Weave pitched handwoven silk made by women weavers from the North-East on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Eri silk, sometimes called peace silk, is made without killing the silkworm, which appeals to ethical buyers.
angle: Assam and Meghalaya produce Eri and Muga silks with GI tags. Stoles, sarees and home textiles in these silks sell to ethical and export buyers. Working with women's weaving groups gives a strong story and a fair supply chain.
